name: monome-dinome
hash_encoding: ASCII uppercase normalized letters, no word spaces
note: The sheet independently prints the complete 3 by 8 box, digit labels, plaintext letters, per-letter codes, and grouped ciphertext. The first two digit-order entries label rows and the remaining eight label columns. I/J and Y/Z share entries. Word spaces and original choices within merged pairs are unrecoverable. The printed ciphertext period is explicitly permitted framing. This is supplied-key recovery, not unknown-key recovery, an unknown-script reading, or a new historical decipherment.
